metadata.name: cuelume-element
metadata.description: An invisible, drop-once initializer that adds curated interaction sounds to the whole app, synthesized live via the Web Audio API with no audio files.
features: Document-wide delegated binding of data-cuelume-* attributes
17 synthesized sounds, no network requests and no audio assets
Global on/off, bindable to a user sound-preference variable
Global volume, bindable to a slider
Play any sound imperatively from a workflow

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Global on/off for every Cuelume sound in the app. Bind it to a user sound-preference variable; this is the intended way to mute from a workflow.

properties.name: volume
properties.description: Global volume multiplier for every Cuelume sound, from 0 (silent) to 1. Values outside that range are clamped.

properties.name: playInEditor
properties.description: Play sounds while editing this page. Has no effect on the published app.

actions.label: Play sound
actions.description: Plays one sound immediately. For cues no attribute can reach, such as success after an API call resolves or error on a failed submit. Silent while the element is disabled.

args.name: Sound
args.description: One of: chime, sparkle, droplet, bloom, whisper, tick, press, release, toggle, success, error, page, loading, ready, pulse, scan, arrival. An unknown name falls back to chime.

args.name: Volume
args.description: Optional volume for this one sound, 0 to 1, multiplied with the global volume. Leave empty to use the global volume alone.

specifications: The element renders nothing in the published app — place a single instance on a layout or shared section, never one per page. The library's enabled flag is global state, so two instances are last-writer-wins.

It emits no sound by itself. To make an element audible, add a data-cuelume-* HTML attribute to that element: data-cuelume-hover (pointerenter, fine mouse only, throttled to 150ms), data-cuelume-press (pointerdown), data-cuelume-release (pointerup), data-cuelume-toggle (click).
Give an attribute a value to override the default sound — data-cuelume-hover="tick" — or leave it empty for the default. Unrecognized names are a silent no-op.
Listeners are delegated on the document, so elements added later (collection lists, modals, anything conditional) work with no rescan.
Browsers play nothing until the user has interacted with the page at least once. A hover sound before any click is a deliberate no-op, not a bug.
